lenders.name: State Bank of India
lenders.rate_text: Rates w.e.f. 15.10.2026: With collateral (above Rs 7.50 lakh to Rs 3.00 crore) 9.65%; without collateral for select institutions (above Rs 7.50 lakh to Rs 50 lakh) 9.65%; with collateral for select institutions 9.15%; takeover 9.15% to 9.65%. 0.50% concession for girl students (non-select institutions). Linked to EBR, floating for entire loan period.
lenders.benchmark: EBR (External Benchmark Rate) = Repo 5.50% + Spread 2.65% = 8.15% (as stated on SBI rate page)
lenders.processing_fee: 0.50% of loan amount, minimum Rs 10,000, maximum Rs 50,000, plus GST
lenders.max_amount_text: Above Rs 7.50 lakh up to Rs 3.00 crore
lenders.collateral: Tangible collateral required; collateral-free up to Rs 50 lakh for select premier institutions. Third-party collateral accepted, not from parents.
lenders.co_applicant: Asset-liability statement and income proof of co-applicant/guarantor required for loans above Rs 7.50 lakh
lenders.margin: No percentage stated; scholarships/assistantships count toward margin; margin brought in year-on-year, pro-rata with disbursements, or upfront
lenders.moratorium: Repayment commences 6 months after completion of course
lenders.moratorium_interest: Simple interest during course and moratorium; accrued interest added to principal, then EMIs fixed
lenders.eligibility: Regular graduate, PG, diploma, certificate, doctoral courses at foreign institutions in USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, New Zealand, UAE and listed European countries
lenders.notes: Product page also shows a headline '6.90% p.a. T&C apply' that does not match the rate table; the rate table (w.e.f. 15.10.2026) is used. Product page title says 'above Rs 20 lakhs' but body says 'above Rs 7.50 lakhs'. Prepayment terms not stated on page.

lenders.name: Bank of Baroda
lenders.rate_text: Floating: Premier institutions abroad BRLLR + 0.55% (8.70%); Non-premier up to Rs 7.50 lakh BRLLR + 2.00% (10.15%); above Rs 7.50 lakh BRLLR + 1.05% (9.20%); Canada non-premier above Rs 7.50 lakh BRLLR + 2.55% (10.70%). Fixed: above Rs 7.50 lakh BRLLR + 2.55% (premier) to BRLLR + 4.55% (Canada non-premier, 12.70%); up to Rs 7.50 lakh Base Rate + 2.00%. Percent values computed from BRLLR 8.15%.
lenders.benchmark: BRLLR (Baroda Repo Linked Lending Rate) 8.15% w.e.f. 08.10.2026 (Repo 5.50% + spread 2.65%)
lenders.processing_fee: Nil up to Rs 7.50 lakh; above Rs 7.50 lakh 1% of loan, max Rs 10,000 + GST (refunded on first disbursement for premier institutions); Rs 8,500 per mortgaged property for advocate/valuer
lenders.collateral: Up to Rs 4 lakh: parent co-obligation, no security; Rs 4-7.50 lakh: third-party guarantee; Rs 7.50-80 lakh: tangible collateral 100% of loan; above Rs 80 lakh: 1.25x security cover
lenders.co_applicant: KYC of applicant and co-applicants; income proof of salaried co-applicant/guarantor
lenders.margin: Premier: nil up to Rs 4 lakh, 15% for Rs 4-7.50 lakh, nil above Rs 7.50 lakh. Non-premier: nil up to Rs 4 lakh, 15% for Rs 4-7.50 lakh, 10% above Rs 7.50 lakh
lenders.moratorium_interest: Simple interest at monthly rests during moratorium; accrued interest added to principal, then EMIs fixed
lenders.prepayment: Nil for fixed-rate loans prepaid from own source; 0.50% of outstanding if taken over by another lender
lenders.eligibility: Indian nationals with admission via entrance test/merit; job-oriented graduate, PG (MCA, MBA, MS), CIMA, CPA and listed premier institution courses
lenders.notes: Effective % values are BRLLR (8.15%) + stated spread, computed by us; product page shows 'Effective Rate of Interest 0.00%' (display bug). Base Rate value not captured, so fixed rate for up to Rs 7.50 lakh not computed. Repayment: 120 instalments up to Rs 7.50 lakh, 180 above.

lenders.name: Punjab National Bank
lenders.rate_text: ROI starting from 8.35% p.a. Floating (non-female): top 50 institutes with 100% collateral RLLR+BSP (8.35%); any amount with 100% collateral RLLR+BSP+1.25% (9.60%); up to Rs 7.50 lakh (CGFSEL) RLLR+BSP+2.00% (10.35%). Fixed: 9.35%-11.85% depending on tenure. Female students: lower spreads (e.g. 9.10%, 9.85%).
lenders.collateral: Up to Rs 7.50 lakh: parents/guardians joint borrowers, no tangible security or third-party guarantee. Above Rs 7.50 lakh: tangible collateral of suitable value
lenders.margin: Nil up to Rs 4 lakh; 15% above Rs 4 lakh; scholarships count toward margin
lenders.eligibility: Resident Indians with admission to higher education abroad via entrance test/merit; job-oriented graduate, PG (MCA, MBA, MS), CIMA, CPA, aviation/shipping courses
lenders.notes: Rates read from PNB retail advances rate page; terms from Udaan product page. Processing fee is on a separate service charges page not checked. Interest treatment during moratorium not stated.

lenders.name: Union Bank of India
lenders.product: Union Education (Abroad Study) / Union Education - Premier Abroad
lenders.rate_text: Rates w.e.f. 08.10.2026. Union Education (inland/abroad): up to Rs 7.50 lakh EBLR+2.00% = 10.25% (female 9.75%); above Rs 7.50 lakh EBLR+1.75% = 10.00% (female 9.50%). Premier Abroad Cat A: up to Rs 40 lakh without collateral 9.50%; up to Rs 150 lakh with 50-<100% collateral 8.75%; 100%+ collateral 8.50%. Cat B: 9.75% / 8.90% / 8.65%.
lenders.processing_fee: Premier Abroad: up to Rs 40 lakh Rs 10,000 + GST; above Rs 40 lakh Rs 20,000 + GST
lenders.max_amount_text: Premier Abroad schemes: min Rs 7.50 lakh, max Rs 150 lakh
lenders.collateral: Premier Cat A: up to Rs 40 lakh no collateral (Cat B up to Rs 30 lakh); above that min 50% tangible collateral; 0.50% concession for 100%+ collateral
lenders.margin: Nil up to Rs 4 lakh, 15% above Rs 4 lakh (general abroad); Premier: 15% in collateral-free band, nil with 100% collateral
lenders.eligibility: Indian nationals admitted to recognized institutions abroad; Premier Cat A list of 160 and Cat B list of 100 institutes (USA, UK, Canada, Germany, Australia, Singapore etc). NRI students not covered under Premier scheme.
lenders.notes: Premier scheme terms from https://www.unionbankofindia.bank.in/en/details/special-union-education-loan-schemes-for-premier-institute-abroad-studies. Percent values are as printed in the sheet (EBLR 8.25% + spread).

lenders.name: Canara Bank
lenders.product: Vidya Sagar (Abroad Studies) / Master's abroad at select top-ranking universities
lenders.rate_text: Vidya Sagar above Rs 7.50 lakh (Abroad Studies) RLLR+1.25% = 9.50%; Master's abroad at select top-ranking universities: 100%+ collateral 9.50%, 75-<100% collateral 10.10%, 50-<75% collateral 10.35%. Vidya Sagar up to Rs 7.50 lakh 10.25%. 0.50% concession for girl students; 0.50% concession for prompt interest servicing during course.
lenders.collateral: Merit quota up to Rs 7.50 lakh: no collateral, covered under CGFSEL; above Rs 7.50 lakh: tangible collateral at least 100% of loan
lenders.margin: Nil up to Rs 4 lakh; above Rs 4 lakh 15% for studies abroad
lenders.prepayment: No prepayment penalty at any time during repayment period
lenders.eligibility: Abroad: courses leading to UG, PG/PhD, PG diploma
lenders.notes: Rate page footer dated 01-04-2026 but RLLR shown w.e.f. 09.10.2026. Terms page is the IBA Model scheme page; max amount for abroad not stated there. Repayment 15 years excludes moratorium.

lenders.name: HDFC Bank
lenders.product: Education Loan for Foreign Education (sourced for Credila Financial Services)
lenders.rate_text: No rate range stated; page only shows an illustrative 12.50% in a tax-savings example
lenders.processing_fee: Origination fee 1.5% of sanction amount + taxes, non-refundable (FAQ separately says up to 1%, min Rs 1,000 for international cases)
lenders.prepayment: Pre-payment charges Nil; NOC charges Nil
lenders.notes: HDFC Bank's page states credit is at the sole discretion of Credila Financial Services Ltd (formerly HDFC Credila), so this is effectively a Credila loan distributed by HDFC Bank. Consider using the Credila entry instead. Origination fee here (1.5%) differs from Credila's own page (1.25%).

lenders.name: ICICI Bank
lenders.rate_text: Abroad studies, starting from: Secured 9.25%, Unsecured 10.50% (Q2 FY2026-27, quarter ending Sept 2026)
lenders.processing_fee: Up to 2% of loan amount + GST; administrative charges Rs 5,000 or 0.25% of loan, whichever is lower
lenders.max_amount_text: Loans up to Rs 3 crore for international and domestic studies
lenders.collateral: Secured options: residential/commercial property, fixed deposit, or existing ICICI home loan (cross-collateral); unsecured also offered
lenders.moratorium_interest: Repayment options during course: PSI (Partial Simple Interest), SI (Simple Interest) or EMI
lenders.notes: Product page shows older 'starting 9.00% / 10.25%'; the rate page (Q2 FY27) shows 9.25% / 10.50% and is used. Only starting rates published; no max rate or benchmark for abroad loans. Moratorium length not stated.

lenders.name: Axis Bank
lenders.product: Axis Bank Education Loan (Prime Abroad / Loan for Higher Study)
lenders.rate_text: Floating, Repo Rate + spread; spread not published
lenders.benchmark: Repo rate (page states current repo 5.25%), reset every 3 months; MCLR 9% for loans before 01.10.2019
lenders.processing_fee: Up to 2% of loan amount + GST
lenders.max_amount_text: Prime Abroad: unsecured loan up to Rs 1 crore; Income Based Funding up to Rs 50 lakh; Working Professionals up to Rs 40 lakh
lenders.collateral: May be asked for appropriate cases (property, Axis FD); no collateral up to Rs 7.5 lakh for Loan for Higher Study

lenders.moratorium: Course tenure + up to 12 months grace (select institutes); FAQ says course + 6 months, extendable to 12
lenders.prepayment: Nil part-payment/foreclosure charges for floating-rate individual loans

Max tenure incl. moratorium capped at 20 years. 22 Oct 2026 re-check: the rate page shows repo 5.25%, while other banks' pages show 5.50% from Oct 2026, so this benchmark may be out of date; the product page also shows a different illustrative table.

lenders.rate_text: Secured education loan from 9.95% p.a. onwards; unsecured rate not published
lenders.benchmark: Credila Benchmark Lending Rate (CBLR) + risk-based spread (value of CBLR not published)
lenders.max_amount_text: No upper limit with collateral; based on eligibility without collateral

lenders.rate_text: Student Loan International: starting at 10.25% p.a.; unsecured loans starting at 11% p.a. Rate = Avanse Base Rate + Spread
lenders.benchmark: Avanse Base Rate 14.55% (w.e.f. 01.12.2024) + spread (spread based on credit and course profiling)
lenders.processing_fee: Up to 2% (schedule of charges); FAQ says around 1-2% of loan amount

lenders.co_applicant: Co-borrower KYC and income details required
lenders.moratorium: Holiday period of up to 6 months after course completion or 3 months after employment, whichever is earlier
lenders.eligibility: Australia, Canada, France, Germany, NZ, Singapore, UK, USA, UAE and others; pre-admission loans only for Master's STEM in USA

lenders.max_amount_text: Covers all education-related costs; no cap stated
lenders.collateral: Optional; can be offered at structuring stage

lenders.rate_text: Variable: fixed margin (e.g. 7.10%, profile-dependent) + variable base rate SOFR 3.80%; representative APR 13.48% (incl. fees). Footer example uses 8.56% + 3.80% = 12.36%.
lenders.processing_fee: Admin fee 4.2% of loan (added to balance) + USD 500 processing fee payable before disbursement
lenders.max_amount_text: No max stated; based on cost of attendance and future earning potential

lenders.prepayment: Early and extra repayments at no additional cost
lenders.eligibility: International postgraduate students (Master's, MBA, professional) at eligible universities/courses

lenders.name: MPOWER Financing
lenders.rate_text: Fixed rates starting at 9.99% (10.89% APR), including 0.25% autopay discount; fixed for life of loan
lenders.max_amount_text: USD 2,001 to USD 100,000 per application; max USD 50,000 per term; total outstanding cap USD 100,000

lenders.eligibility: Students admitted to 50+ eligible US and Canadian schools, within 30 months of finishing master's/MBA (24 months for bachelor's)

tax_benefit.text: Section 80E: deduction for interest paid on loan for higher education of self or relative; amount = total interest paid (no cap stated); principal not deductible. Available only under the old tax regime (not under new regime u/s 115BAC). Lender name, loan account number, sanction date, loan amount and outstanding balance must be reported in the ITR. The 8-year limit (initial AY + 7 following) is widely cited but could not be confirmed on an official page we could open.
